summary: CC2026 Iteration 33 - Complete testing of Smart Engine Analytics and Coleen Workspace. Backend: 24/24 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All UI elements verified via Playwright. Analytics tracking active, Site Analytics Dashboard displays all KPIs, Coleen Workspace CRUD operations working.

issues: React hydration warnings about span in tbody/tr - cosmetic issue from visual editor spans, doesn't affect functionality

tests: Accepts page_view events with IP and user_agent capture
Accepts multiple events in batch
Accepts click events
Returns success: true and count of events stored
Returns summary with total_page_views, unique_visitors, unique_ips, total_events, avg_pages_per_session
Returns daily traffic breakdown array
Returns top_pages array with page, views, visitors
Returns devices breakdown (mobile/desktop counts)
Returns referrers array with source and count
Returns hourly_today array
Returns recent_activity array with IP addresses
SmartAnalytics initializes on page load (console: [SmartAnalytics] Initialized)
Page views tracked when navigating between pages
Events stored in MongoDB analytics_events collection
CC2026admin password grants admin role and redirects to /admin
Invalid password returns 401
Dashboard accessible after admin login
KPI cards display: Pages vues, Visiteurs uniques, Pages/session, Evenements
Traffic chart (Trafic quotidien) displays daily data
Device breakdown shows Desktop vs Mobile percentages
Top pages list shows most visited pages
Sources de trafic shows referrer domains
Trafic aujourd'hui (par heure) shows hourly distribution
Activite recente table shows recent visitors with IP and device type
Coleen2026 password grants partnerships role
Redirects to /workspace/coleen
Dashboard shows 4 stat cards: Partenaires, Signés, Contacts, Budget engagé
Pipeline Partenariats shows status breakdown
En cours de négociation section shows active partners
Analytics CC2026 section shows badges/jetons stats
GET /api/shared/partners returns list (8 partners including 3 existing)
POST /api/shared/partners creates new partner
PATCH /api/shared/partners/{id} updates partner status
DELETE /api/shared/partners/{id} removes partner
Partners tab displays all partners with type badges and status
GET /api/shared/contacts?owner=Coleen returns contacts list
POST /api/shared/contacts creates new contact
DELETE /api/shared/contacts/{id} removes contact
Add Contact form works via UI
Contacts tab displays contacts with category badges
GET /api/shared/expenses returns expenses list

Add Expense form works via UI
Budget tab shows expenses grouped by category with totals
